ctx.x: Did you have other friends in the union, that were officials in the union, that worked...

No, these were my first friends. Oh, no. Walton. He used to be in the pit, the colored man. In the pit. The first colored man in the pit in 1925 playin' trumpet. And we became friendly, yeah. And he's been there...and, of course, Andy Kirk came in later, he's in the union too, yeah.
There's one other thing that I wanted to mention that requires going back a bit, I think. You mentioned, just yesterday I think it was, having belonged to the Masons at one time.
